tasks.title: W2 Meta OAuth diagnostic
tasks.prompt:
# MISSAO
Read-only W2 Meta OAuth Diagnostic Tree for Kloel. Inspect the repo and report exact code evidence for steps 1-9 of the Meta OAuth Diagnostic Tree: generated OAuth URL, redirect_uri, env resolution, callback route, canonical backend domain logic, state fields, app/version/config-id usage, requested scopes, frontend return redirect.

# ARQUIVOS PERMITIDOS
backend/src/meta/**, backend/src/marketing/**, frontend/src/components/kloel/marketing/**, frontend/src/app/(main)/marketing/**, frontend/src/app/api/marketing/**, docs/implementation/**

# ARQUIVOS PROIBIDOS
All files outside ARQUIVOS PERMITIDOS. Do not edit anything. Do not read .env files. Do not print secrets.

# PRE-LEITURA OBRIGATORIA
AGENTS.md (GLOBAL_AGENT_RULE), docs/implementation/kloel-cia-rule-applicability.md, docs/implementation/kloel-cia-gap-inventory.md, docs/implementation/kloel-cia-vision-traceability.md.

# COMPORTAMENTO ESPERADO
No code changes. Produce a concise diagnostic report with file:line citations and classify each step as PASS, GAP, or EXTERNAL_BLOCKED.

# COMANDOS DE VALIDACAO PERMITIDOS
rg, sed, git diff --stat. No tests, no package install, no network, no git writes.

# CRITERIO DE SUCESSO
Report includes exact redirect_uri generation path, callback path, state shape, requested scopes, config-id envs used, and any mismatch against the contract.

# CRITERIO DE FALHA
Any file edit, secret output, broad refactor suggestion without evidence, or claim without file path evidence.

# FORMATO DE RELATORIO
- summary
- Diagnostic Tree steps 1-9 with evidence
- gaps/risks
- recommended next patch if needed

# REGRAS DE SEGURANCA
Never print env values or secrets. Never edit files. Never use git reset/restore/clean/push. Redact tokens/keys if seen.

# REGRA DE CONFLITO
If repo evidence contradicts this prompt, stop and report the contradiction.
